[b][size=4]Known Issues : [/size][/b]
 [list]
[*]Animation freeze / obelisk not updating after saving configuration choices in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] when animation is enabled:
[list][*]Type into the SMAPI window, " [b]cpa reload[/b] ", hit enter.
[*]OR [b]reloading game will fix it[/b] (ESC > exit to desktop) - [i]if you don't use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [u]reload game for config updates, ignore this bullet point.[/u][/i]
[*][b]options[/b] will [b]update per configuration save[/b] if you preview them [u][b]while animation options are disabled[/b][/u], after the initial, "cpa reload" in SMAPI window (final "[b]cpa reload[/b]" [b][u]after[/u][/b] you've [b]decided[/b] on your [b]configurations[/b])
[*]
[/list][*]For [AT] [b]alternative textures[/b] to work, the [b]bottom left floor tile[/b] must be [b]removed[/b] in order to switch textures properly
[list][*][u]add the floor tile after you're done[/u]
[/list][spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/27211/27211-1724931135-2095076858.png[/img][/spoiler][/list]
